release_notes: v9.8.34 (guid-preflight-only) — SECOND-LEVEL FIX after v9.8.33 still crashed Tally on Krishna Sales Corp's PC even with only 1 company loaded. New model: (1) the dedicated GUID Collection XML is REMOVED — GUID is now fetched as a SIDE-EFFECT of the existing v9.8.31 `list_of_companies` request (byte-identical shape, one extra `<FETCH>GUID</FETCH>` line the customer's Tally has already been tolerating for weeks); (2) `fetch_company_guid()` is now pure dict-lookup on the `_guid_cache` warmed by preflight — zero Tally XML calls from the sync loops; (3) a `disable_guid_lookup` per-tenant kill-switch (settable via new super-admin route `PUT /super-admin/admins/{u}/toggle-guid-lookup` or directly in Mongo) makes the agent behave exactly like v9.8.31 (no GUID XML at all). Ships with the backend serving the flag through `/api/auth/me`, so support can unblock any tenant WITHOUT touching the .exe. Also: version_info.txt bumped to 9.8.34.0.
